segments.ja359:1.1: Vikkama re haripāda [mahāmiga (sī. syā. pī.)], vikkama re mahāmiga [harīpada (sī. syā. pī.)];
segments.ja359:1.3: Chinda vārattikaṃ pāsaṃ, nāhaṃ ekā vane rame.
segments.ja359:2.1: Vikkamāmi na pāremi, bhūmiṃ sumbhāmi vegasā;
segments.ja359:2.3: Daḷho vārattiko pāso, pādaṃ me parikantati.
segments.ja359:3.3: Paṭhamaṃ maṃ vadhitvāna, hana pacchā mahāmigaṃ.
segments.ja359:4.1: Na me sutaṃ vā diṭṭhaṃ vā, bhāsantiṃ mānusiṃ migiṃ [na me sutā vā diṭṭhā vā, bhāsantī mānusiṃ migī (ṭīkā)];
segments.ja359:4.3: Tvañca bhadde sukhī hohi, eso cāpi mahāmigo.
segments.ja359:5.1: Evaṃ luddaka nandassu, saha sabbehi ñātibhi;
